name: Back up and restore personal files
description: Make a second copy of personal files and prove you can restore one of them.
emoji_rationale: The floppy disk marks a saved copy you can bring back.

levels.name: Copy one set of files
levels.completion_criterion: Copy one folder of personal files to a second place and check that the copy opens.
levels.can_do: You can make a second copy and see that it opens.
levels.safety_requirements: Keep the copy separate from the only original. Do not invent an encryption method.

levels.name: Restore a file
levels.completion_criterion: Delete or rename a practice copy and restore that file from the backup.
levels.can_do: You can bring one file back from the copy.
levels.safety_requirements: Use a practice copy, not the only original of an important file.

levels.name: Check the backup after a change
levels.completion_criterion: Change one file, make a new copy, and show which version you would use if the working copy were lost.
levels.can_do: You can tell the saved copy from the working copy.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not treat two folders on the same device as protection against losing that device.

safety_notes: Pilot proposal only. Levels are an editorial adaptation of the ESCO description in the pack-11 bundle. The source page was not re-opened.

name: Read a household gas meter
description: Record what a household gas meter shows. This is not a repair or a leak check.
emoji_rationale: The numbers stand for the figures you record from the meter.

levels.name: Record one reading
levels.completion_criterion: Read the figures on a household gas meter and write the number with the date.
levels.can_do: You can record one reading without changing the meter.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not open pipes or fittings. If you smell gas, leave and contact the local emergency service. Do not investigate the smell.

levels.name: Compare two readings
levels.completion_criterion: Compare a new reading with an earlier one and say whether use went up, down or stayed too close to call.
levels.can_do: You can compare two readings of the same meter.
levels.safety_requirements: A difference is not a diagnosis of a leak or of an appliance fault.

levels.name: Explain the record
levels.completion_criterion: Show someone else the reading, the date and what the meter is measuring, and mark anything you could not read.
levels.can_do: You can hand over a reading that another person can check.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not adjust the meter or estimate a digit you could not see.

safety_notes: Pilot proposal only. Levels are an editorial adaptation of the ESCO description in the pack-11 bundle. The source page was not re-opened.

name: Capture speech in your own notes
description: Turn a short stretch of speech into notes you can read back. The source does not name a shorthand system, so none is required.
emoji_rationale: The pencil is the note you make while someone is speaking.

levels.name: Note a short message
levels.completion_criterion: Write a short spoken message in abbreviations you choose and read it back accurately later the same day.
levels.can_do: You can recover a short message from your own notes.
levels.safety_requirements: The source does not require a named shorthand system.

levels.name: Capture a minute of speech
levels.completion_criterion: Take notes during about one minute of speech and read back the points you captured, marking gaps.
levels.can_do: You can keep the main points of a short explanation.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not fill a gap with a guess.

levels.name: Review the notes
levels.completion_criterion: Compare your notes with the original speech or a recording that you are allowed to use, and correct one repeated miss.
levels.can_do: You can find a miss and change the way you note it.
levels.safety_requirements: Use only speech you are allowed to record or replay.

safety_notes: Pilot proposal only. Levels are an editorial adaptation of the ESCO description in the pack-11 bundle. The source page was not re-opened.

name: Plan a small event
description: Turn a gathering into an agenda, a simple budget and a check against one real constraint.
emoji_rationale: The calendar is the agenda and timing of the event.

levels.name: Write the agenda and budget
levels.completion_criterion: For a small gathering, write the purpose, the order of the occasion and a simple list of costs.
levels.can_do: You can show what will happen and what it is expected to cost.
levels.safety_requirements: Food safety is a separate practice. Do not add medical or alcohol rules that the source does not state.

levels.name: Match one constraint
levels.completion_criterion: Check the plan against the number of people and one real limit, such as the room or the time, and change the plan if it does not fit.
levels.can_do: You can adjust the plan to a real limit.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not assume a venue is available because it appears in the plan.

levels.name: Review the result
levels.completion_criterion: After the gathering, or after a realistic rehearsal of the plan, note one thing to change next time and why.
levels.can_do: You can use the outcome to change the next plan.
levels.safety_requirements: A review is not a promise that every guest was satisfied.

safety_notes: Pilot proposal only. Levels are an editorial adaptation of the ESCO description in the pack-11 bundle. The source page was not re-opened.

name: Notice signs of wood rot
description: Look and listen for signs of rot and write down what you found for someone qualified.
emoji_rationale: The wood marks an inspection of timber, not a repair.

levels.name: Look and listen
levels.completion_criterion: On one wooden element, look for visible signs of rot and note what sound it makes when you tap it.
levels.can_do: You can describe what you saw and heard.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not cut out, treat or load structural timber. Stop if the piece is part of a floor, stair or roof.

levels.name: Compare two pieces
levels.completion_criterion: Compare the suspect piece with a sound piece nearby and write which differences you can actually see or hear.
levels.can_do: You can separate a difference from a guess about the cause.
levels.safety_requirements: A different sound is not proof of the kind of rot or of the repair.

levels.name: Write a note for a qualified person
levels.completion_criterion: Record the place, the date and the signs, and state that you are not choosing a treatment.
levels.can_do: You can hand over an observation without prescribing a repair.
levels.safety_requirements: Treatment and structural repair stay with a qualified person.

safety_notes: Pilot proposal only. Levels are an editorial adaptation of the ESCO description in the pack-11 bundle. The source page was not re-opened.

name: Check a surface before painting
description: Check scratches, dirt, moisture and old covering, and say whether the surface is ready.
emoji_rationale: The brush marks the painting job that should wait until the surface is ready.

levels.name: Inspect the surface
levels.completion_criterion: On one surface, note scratches, dents, grease, dirt, moisture and traces of an old covering.
levels.can_do: You can list what would get in the way of paint.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not name or mix a solvent. If a product is needed, follow its label.

levels.name: Remove only loose dirt
levels.completion_criterion: Remove loose dust or dirt by a method that does not require a chemical you have not identified, and look again.
levels.can_do: You can show the difference after removing loose dirt.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not scrape a surface that may contain old lead paint. Stop and ask a qualified person if you suspect it.

levels.name: Decide readiness
levels.completion_criterion: Say whether the surface looks ready, or what sign still blocks painting, without choosing a coating product.
levels.can_do: You can give a ready or not-ready decision with a reason.
levels.safety_requirements: Porosity and the need for a coating are noted, not solved by an invented recipe.

name: Make a simple technical drawing
description: Make a labeled drawing of a simple object that another person can recognise.
emoji_rationale: The triangle is a measured drawing rather than a sketch.

levels.name: Draw one labeled view
levels.completion_criterion: Use drawing software to make one view of a simple object and label its main parts.
levels.can_do: You can produce a view that names the parts.
levels.safety_requirements: No particular software brand is required.

levels.name: Add measurements you took
levels.completion_criterion: Measure the object and put those measurements on the drawing, including the unit.
levels.can_do: You can connect the drawing to measurements.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not invent a dimension you did not measure.

levels.name: Check with another person
levels.completion_criterion: Give the drawing to someone else and ask them to name the object and one dimension. Note any miss.
levels.can_do: You can tell whether the drawing communicates.
levels.safety_requirements: A miss is a revision of the drawing, not a fault in the object.

safety_notes: Pilot proposal only. Levels are an editorial adaptation of the ESCO description in the pack-11 bundle. The source page was not re-opened.

name: Compare equipment before buying
description: Compare equipment or parts on what they must do, price and delivery time.
emoji_rationale: The basket is a purchase choice, not a financial product.

levels.name: State the job
levels.completion_criterion: Write what the equipment or part must do, and two limits that matter, such as size or a deadline.
levels.can_do: You can say what the purchase is for.
levels.safety_requirements: This is not a comparison of loans or interest.

levels.name: Compare two offers
levels.completion_criterion: Find two offers and record the price and the delivery time of each, with the source of the figures.
levels.can_do: You can put two offers side by side.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not treat a missing price as zero.

levels.name: Choose and mark the gap
levels.completion_criterion: Say which offer you would choose and one fact the sources still do not tell you.
levels.can_do: You can separate a choice from an unknown.
levels.safety_requirements: A choice is not a claim that the equipment is safe or suitable for a regulated job.

name: Explain a small crowdfunding project
description: State a project, what the money is for, and what is still uncertain. Do not copy a platform's campaign template.
emoji_rationale: The handshake is an ask made to other people under a platform's rules.

levels.name: State the project
levels.completion_criterion: Write what the project is, what the money is for and what a backer would receive, in your own words.
levels.can_do: You can explain the ask without a platform template.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not promise a reward the project cannot deliver.

levels.name: Check the platform rules
levels.completion_criterion: Read the rules of one real platform and mark which of your statements those rules allow.
levels.can_do: You can tell your draft from the platform's conditions.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not copy the platform's text into the proposal.

levels.name: Mark uncertainty
levels.completion_criterion: Revise the explanation so a reader can see what is already decided and what is still unknown, including the budget gap.
levels.can_do: You can show the limit of the claim.
levels.safety_requirements: Monitoring donors and social media are not required by these levels.

name: Make and check a reservation
description: Book a restaurant, hotel or journey and check that the confirmation matches the request.
emoji_rationale: The notebook is the booking details and the confirmation.

levels.name: Collect the request
levels.completion_criterion: Write the date, place, number of people and any limit you must not miss for a restaurant, hotel or journey.
levels.can_do: You can state the booking before you make it.
levels.safety_requirements: Use a booking you are allowed to make.

levels.name: Save the confirmation
levels.completion_criterion: Complete one booking and check that the confirmation matches the date, place and party size.
levels.can_do: You can show a confirmation that matches the request.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not enter payment details into a page you do not trust. The source does not add a payment procedure.

levels.name: Change or cancel from the stated rules
levels.completion_criterion: Using the provider's own rules, change or cancel the practice booking, or write the deadline if a change is no longer allowed.
levels.can_do: You can follow the provider's rule instead of guessing it.
levels.safety_requirements: A fee or a refusal comes from the provider, not from an invented policy.
